name: North Region
eyebrow: North Region · Woodlands, Yishun and Mandai
title: North Region:
title_em: the causeway, the wildlife and the wetlands.
tagline: Woodlands and the Causeway to Johor, Mandai's wildlife parks, Sungei Buloh and Kranji.
summary: The North Region faces Malaysia across the Straits of Johor. Woodlands has the Causeway and the Checkpoint, Yishun and Sembawang are big residential towns, and Mandai holds the Singapore Zoo, Night Safari and Bird Paradise.
Further west are the Kranji countryside, with its farms and the Kranji War Memorial, and the Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve, a rest stop for migratory birds.

sport.intro: Woodlands Wellington are the football club of the north, playing at Woodlands Stadium, and the Kranji area has the old racecourse.

community.intro: Singaporeans from Woodlands and Yishun often have family links across the Causeway to Malaysia, and these ties extend overseas.

ancestry: Tracing your family in Singapore? The National Archives of Singapore and the National Library Board hold oral histories, newspapers, maps and records, and many are searchable online.
